Exam point: teeke ke virodh ke peechhe 'Shakti' yaani urja roop me God ka vishwas tatha devi 'Jagdamba' ke krodh ka bhay tha; samanya halat me vaccination ka virodh nahi hota tha tatha 1921-22 me 62,981 teeke safal hue.

qe: Besides the Patna General Hospital, which three hospitals of the district were state institutions, the rest being supported from Local Funds?
qh: पटना जनरल अस्पताल के अतिरिक्त जिले के कौन-से तीन अस्पताल राजकीय संस्थान थे, जबकि शेष स्थानीय निधि से चलते थे?
oe: Those at Patna City, Barh and Bihar
Those at Gulzarbagh, Gardanibagh and Bikram
Those at Khagaul, Fatuha and Bakhtiarpur
Those at Maner, Punpun and Mokameh
oh: पटना सिटी, बाढ़ तथा बिहार के अस्पताल
गुलज़ारबाग, गरदनीबाग तथा बिक्रम के अस्पताल
खगौल, फतुहा तथा बख्तियारपुर के अस्पताल
मनेर, पुनपुन तथा मोकामा के अस्पताल
e: Jile ki chikitsa-vyavastha do tarah ki thi - sarkari (state) sansthayein tatha Local Funds yaani sthaniya nidhi se chalne wale aspatal aur dawakhanne. Rajkiya sansthanon me Patna General Hospital tatha Gulzarbagh, Gardanibagh aur Bikram ke aspatal shamil the. Sthaniya nidhi se chalne wale aspatal Patna City, Barh, Bihar tatha Dinapore me the, jabki Maner, Punpun, Khusrupur, Karai-Parsarai, Mokameh, Rajgir, Bharatpura, Khagaul, Masaurhi, Chandi, Islampur, Fatuha, Bakhtiarpur, Harnaut tatha Paliganj me dawakhanne the. 1922 me Patna General Hospital par kharch Rs 1,24,200 hua tatha anya sarkari aspatalon par Rs 18,740. Exam point: Patna General Hospital ke alawa Gulzarbagh, Gardanibagh tatha Bikram ke aspatal rajkiya sansthayein thi, jabki Patna City, Barh, Bihar aur Dinapore ke aspatal sthaniya nidhi se chalte the.

qe: The number of patients treated in the hospitals and dispensaries of the district rose from 119,000 in 1895 and 160,000 in 1905 to how many by 1922?
qh: जिले के अस्पतालों तथा दवाखानों में इलाज कराने वालों की संख्या 1895 में 119,000 तथा 1905 में 160,000 से बढ़कर 1922 तक कितनी हो गई?
e: Jile ke aspatalon tatha dawakhanon me ilaj karane walon ki sankhya varsh-dar-varsh badhti gayi - 1895 me 119,000, 1905 me 160,000 tatha 1922 me 257,000. Isse pata chalta hai ki yuropiy yaani angrezi chikitsa-paddhati logon me lokpriya hoti gayi. 1922 me Patna General Hospital me hi 10,636 surgical operations yaani shalya-chikitsa ke operation hue; anya sarkari aspatalon me 1,466, sthaniya nidhi ke aspatalon me 13,226 tatha dawakhanon me 5,657 operations hue. Is avadhi me rogon ke aankde bhi rakhe jaate the, jinme enteric fever, kala-azar, malaria, dysentery tatha aankhon tatha kaan ke rog pramukh the. Exam point: ilaj karane walon ki sankhya 1895 ke 119,000 se badh kar 1922 me 257,000 ho gayi, jo angrezi chikitsa-paddhati ki badhti lokpriyta darshata hai; 1922 me Patna General Hospital me 10,636 operations hue.

qe: How many surgical operations were performed at the Patna General Hospital during the year 1922?
qh: वर्ष 1922 में पटना जनरल अस्पताल में कितने शल्य-चिकित्सा के ऑपरेशन किए गए?
e: 1922 me Patna General Hospital me 10,636 surgical operations yaani shalya-chikitsa ke operation kiye gaye, jo jile ke kisi bhi sansthan me sabse adhik the. Usi varsh anya sarkari aspatalon me 1,466, sthaniya nidhi se chalne wale aspatalon me 13,226 tatha dawakhanon me 5,657 operations hue. Operations ki sankhya se yah pata chalta hai ki bade aspatal par shalya-chikitsa ka bhair kitna tha tatha chhoti sansthaon me zyadatar rogi davai tatha salah ke liye aate the. Sthaniya nidhi ke aspatalon tatha dawakhanon me krishi-karya se jude logon ko nazdiki ilaj uplabdh karana unka mukhya uddeshya tha. Exam point: 1922 me Patna General Hospital me 10,636 operations hue, jabki anya sarkari aspatalon me 1,466, sthaniya nidhi ke aspatalon me 13,226 aur dawakhanon me 5,657 operations hue.

qe: Expenditure on the Patna General Hospital during the year 1922 was how much?
qh: वर्ष 1922 के दौरान पटना जनरल अस्पताल पर कितना व्यय हुआ?
e: 1922 me Patna General Hospital par Rs 1,24,200 kharch hua; anya sarkari aspatalon par Rs 18,740 tatha sthaniya nidhi se chalne wale aspatalon tatha dawakhanon par Rs 1,01,700 kharch hua. Isse pata chalta hai ki jile ki chikitsa-vyavastha me sabse badi rashi bade sarkari aspatal par kharch hoti thi, jabki sthaniya nidhi ke aspatalon tatha dawakhanon ko mila kar lagbhag utna hi dhan diya jaata tha. Chikitsa tatha safai jaise kaamon ke kharch ki tulna karne se yah bhi samajh aata hai ki jile ke sadhan seemit the tatha unka badlav dheere-dheere hota tha. Exam point: 1922 me Patna General Hospital par Rs 1,24,200, anya sarkari aspatalon par Rs 18,740 tatha sthaniya nidhi ke aspatalon-dawakhanon par Rs 1,01,700 kharch hua.

qe: In the year 1919-20 the expenditure of the District Board on sanitation was how much?
qh: वर्ष 1919-20 में जिला बोर्ड का स्वच्छता पर कितना व्यय था?
e: 1919-20 me District Board yaani jila parishad ka swachhta par kharch Rs 18,527 tha. Jile ke gaon me swachhta-sudhar ke kaam mushkil the, kyunki log vyaktigat safai ka to dhyaan rakhte the, lekin apne aas-paas ki gandi paristhiti ke prati udaasin the; gaon ka sthal ganda, pashuon se bhara tatha nali-paani se rahit hota tha. Iske bawajood Local Boards ne kai swachhta-sudhar ke kaam kiye - jaruriyat se zyada gaddhe bhar diye gaye, ghan ugane wali jhaadiyan saaf ki gayin tatha gandagi hatayi gayi; is kaam me ve poore prant ke liye aadarsh maane jaate the. Exam point: 1919-20 me District Board ka swachhta-kharch Rs 18,527 tha; Local Boards ne gaddhe bharna, jhaadiyan saaf karna tatha gandagi hatana jaise kaam karke poore prant ke liye udaharan sthapit kiya.

qe: The Municipal Act, under which great improvements in water-supply, drainage, street cleaning and sewage were effected in the towns, was introduced in which year?
qh: नगरों में जल-आपूर्ति, नाली-निकासी, गली-सफाई तथा मल-निष्कासन में बड़े सुधार जिस नगरपालिका अधिनियम के तहत हुए, वह किस वर्ष लागू किया गया?
e: Nagaron me swachhta ka kaam gaon se zyada mushkil tha, kyunki ghar mukhya sadkon tatha tang galion me ek doosre se sate hue the; behtar shreni ke ghar bina hawa-aane-jaane ki vyavastha ke banaye jaate the, jabki zyadatar ghar mitti ke, halke unche chabutare par bane tatha logon se bhare hote the. 1884 me Municipal Act lagu hone ke baad nagarpalikaon ko paani ki aapurti, drainage, gali ki safai tatha sewage yaani mal-nishkasan jaise vishayon par kaam karne ki shakti mili. Iske baad kai sudhar hue, lekin samay kam tatha nagarpalikaon ke paas dhan ki kami thi, isliye saikdon varsh ki udaasini se paida hui gandagi poori tarah door nahi ho saki. Exam point: 1884 me Municipal Act lagu hua, jisse nagarpalikaon ko paani, drainage, gali-safai tatha sewage ke vishayon par kaam karne ki shakti mili; iske baad kaafi sudhar hue, lekin dhan ki kami ke kaaran sab samasyayein door nahi hui.

qe: Under the sanitary operations of the Local Boards, sweepers were employed in the larger villages under the control of whom?
qh: स्थानीय बोर्डों के स्वच्छता-कार्यों के अंतर्गत बड़े गाँवों में भंगियों/सफ़ाईकर्मियों को किसके नियंत्रण में लगाया गया?
oe: A village headman or respectable resident
oh: गाँव का मुखिया या किसी सम्मानित निवासी
e: Bade gaonon me swachhta banaye rakhne ke liye Local Boards ne safai-karmiyon ki niyukti ki tatha unke kaam ka prabhar gaon ke mukhiya ya kisi sammanit nivasi par daala. Gaon me kaam ye the - jaruriyat se zyada gaddhe bharna, tez ugane wali jhadiyan saaf karna tatha gandagi hatana. Is tarah ki vyavastha se gaon ke logon ki sahbhagita bhi badhi, kyunki safai ka prabhar bahar ke karmachari ke sthan par gaon ke hi prabhavshali vyakti ke paas tha. Isi tarah gaon ke chaukidar janm-mrityu ki suchna police tak pahunchate the, jo jile ke svasthya aankdon ka adhar banti thi. Exam point: bade gaonon me safai-karmiyon ka prabhar gaon ke mukhiya ya kisi sammanit nivasi ke paas tha tatha unka kaam gaddhe bharna, jhadiyan saaf karna tatha gandagi hatana tha.

qe: In the villages of the district, why was the water of the tanks a danger to health?
qh: जिले के गाँवों में तालाबों का पानी स्वास्थ्य के लिए खतरा क्यों था?
oe: They were used only for watering cattle
They were too deep ever to be cleaned
Drains were apt to find their way into them and they were used indiscriminately for cooking and bathing
They were always dry in the hot weather
oh: उनका उपयोग केवल पशुओं को पानी पिलाने में होता था
वे इतने गहरे थे कि साफ़ कभी नहीं हो सकते थे
उनमें नालियाँ आ कर मिल जाती थीं तथा वे खाना बनाने और नहाने दोनों के लिए बिना भेदभाव प्रयोग होती थीं
गर्मी में वे हमेशा सूखे रहते थे
e: Gaon ke log apni vyaktigat safai ka to poora dhyaan rakhte the, lekin apne aas-paas ki gandi paristhiti ke prati udaasin the tatha lok-swachhta ki bhawna unme kam thi. Gaon ka sthal ganda, pashuon se bhara tatha nali-paani ki vyavastha se rahit hota tha; ghar andhere tatha bina hawa ke hote the, jinhe aas-paas ke gaddhe se nikali mitti se banaya jaata tha, jisse wahi gaddha thehra hua ganda kunda ban jaata tha. Kuon ki theek tarah suraksha nahi hoti thi tatha ghar ka maila paani unki or aa jaata tha; isi prakar talabon me naliyan mil jaati thi tatha unhi ka paani khana banane aur nahane ke liye bina kisi bhed ke use hota tha. Exam point: talabon me naliyon ka paani mil jaata tha tatha unhi ka paani khana banane aur nahane dono kaam aata tha; isi karan paani se phailne wale rog - cholera tatha dysentery - gaon me aam the.
